title: Sync audit source metrics after audit completion
summary: Synced audit source table metrics after successful audit process completion and refreshed the live audit-source registry with the completed run's source counts.
reason: A completed Reports audit updated audit_progress.json and report files, but the Locations table reads media, sidecar, folder, and scan-status fields from Audit/audit_sources.json. That registry was never refreshed by Start Audit completion, so rows stayed Not scanned with zero counts.
behavior_before: After Start Audit Selected completed, the progress bars showed 3030/3030 and report generation complete, but the selected Locations rows still showed Not scanned, Video files 0, Sidecars 0, Folders 0, and Last scan '-'.
behavior_after: After a successful audit process exits, the backend runs the existing read-only audit-source scan for the launched source rows and writes their media, sidecar, folder, scan-status, and last-scan fields back to Audit/audit_sources.json for the Locations table.
manual_validation: Ran live backend audit-source sync for E:\Videos\Scratch\State\Audit\audit_sources.json. Result: 3030 media file(s), 2708 sidecar file(s), and 805 folder(s) across 2 source rows.
Verified live rows: \\LAYNE-SERVER\Users\Layne\Videos\outsource -> complete, 0 media, 0 sidecars, 3 folders; \\LAYNE-SERVER\share\Video -> complete, 3030 media, 2708 sidecars, 802 folders.
rollback_plan: Revert the audit-source sync helper, the optional process completion hook, the desktop service mixin wiring, and the added tests; refresh generated summaries. Runtime table metrics can be reset by removing and re-adding the affected Audit source rows or by restoring the previous Audit/audit_sources.json if needed.
notes:
Add completed-audit source metrics sync using existing read-only source scan.
Call optional post-exit audit source sync hook after successful process completion update.
Expose audit source metrics sync mixin on the desktop service.
Cover completed audit sync of selected source metrics and service hook behavior.
